egress.terms: Free; media served from Microsoft's CDN, chat-attached files via OneDrive share links

tooling: No public Teams-free file API; attachments land in OneDrive, so Graph API against the backing OneDrive is the usable path. Wrapper-only for the media path.
chaining: 5 GB x unlimited free Microsoft accounts (OneDrive-backed); separately the media path is per-record unlimited - 'share as many photos and videos as you want' - which is the interesting half: an image/video album with no byte cap, multiplied by unlimited free accounts.
limits_note: 250 GB max per individual file in OneDrive (personal); 100 MB per file in the Teams channel Files UI; media path takes images/video only, no arbitrary binaries; chat history limits are separate from file limits
